submitted.rationale: With only 3 merit measurements, I compared the FeVO4-like region against the Fe-rich (hematite-like) corner. The Fe-rich composition 175 (Fe0.61 Ni0.22 V0.18) gave the highest photocurrent: 7.7e-7 A. Nearby 49 gave 7.0e-7 A, and the FeVO4-like 144 gave 4.1e-7 A.

rejected.reason: FeVO4-like Fe:V≈1:1 composition gave 4.1e-7 A, about half of 175
Even more Fe-rich neighbour gave 7.0e-7 A, slightly lower than 175
Not measured because the budget was too small. The first two results pointed toward Fe-rich compositions
